ai_diagnostic.headline: The £366k Rent Trap & Lunchtime Delivery Chokehold
ai_diagnostic.why_underperforming: Despite generating the highest gross revenue in the entire chain (£1.11M), Piccadilly loses £49,697 net. The single biggest factor is crippling rent of £30,500/month (£366,000/year, 33% of revenue!). Moreover, store manager Ollie Brent neglects rent as "head office problem", while lunchtime delivery orders flood tablets for single £3.50 coffees, creating 12-person till queues and driving lucrative commuter footfall away to station concourse competitors. Staff turnover is catastrophic at 220% (53 leavers).
actionable_recommendations: Urgent Lease Renegotiation: Piccadilly rent (£30.5k/mo) must be renegotiated or structured into a turnover-linked base + variable model with the transit landlord.
Install Dedicated Delivery Hatch: Split delivery rider collection away from physical barista counter or pause low-value delivery orders during peak 12:00-13:30 rush.
Add 2 Peak Lunch Shifts: Increase barista staffing from 3 to 5 during lunch rush to capture lost commuters walking out. Will generate an estimated +£65k in retained sales.
Enact £0.50/hr Lunch Retention Premium: Stem the 220% barista turnover to competitors on concourse.

ai_diagnostic.why_underperforming: Opened in September 2025 with £385,000 fitout capex. Operating margin is only 5.0% (£24,961 profit on £498k sales). Located just 0.4 miles from Leeds Briggate (S03), it directly cannibalized ~25% of Briggate’s sales, while Briggate failed to adjust food par levels, leading to £16.6k of wasted food.
actionable_recommendations: Differentiate Value Proposition: Turn Trinity into the fast grab-and-go student/retail hub and position Briggate as the artisanal sit-down experiential café.
Synchronize Par Levels: Recalibrate bakery and lunch par levels across both Leeds sites to eliminate redundant prepared stock.
Drive Evening / Student Footfall: Introduce post-15:00 study promotions and meal deals to optimize fixed rent.
